I dreamt my teeth were crumbling and falling out one by one into my hands.
I was being chased through a dark forest by someone I couldn't see, and no matter how hard I tried I couldn't run fast enough.
I was flying low over my childhood house, looking down at everyone in the garden below.
There was a snake coiled in the corner of my bedroom. It watched me but never struck.
I was standing at the front of a crowded lecture hall with no clothes on, and everyone was staring at me.
I kept trying to call my mother but the phone numbers dissolved every time I dialed them.
